fields.rationale: party_role_category is the publisher's broad capacity of the party on the application; mapped to the party-owned role_category concept. The when-guard restricts emission to non-blank source values so that 'other' means a publisher category outside the enumerated subset (e.g. licensee), never a missing value; blank categories are declined rather than coerced to 'unknown'.

party_role is the specific role label, a distinct dimension from party_role_category; kept separate so applicant/patentee/agent are not collapsed and an agent row is not read as ownership. The when-guard restricts emission to non-blank source values so 'other' denotes a publisher role label outside the enumerated subset, not a missing value; blank roles are declined rather than coerced to 'unknown'.
